recommendedTextbook.title: Basic Technology for Junior Secondary Schools 2
recommendedTextbook.author: G.N. Nneji, O.M. Olaitan
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education & NERDC

topics.topic: First-Angle Orthographic Projection: Principal Planes and Standard Views
subtopics: Concept of projection and difference between pictorial and orthographic drawings
Principal planes of projection: Vertical Plane (VP) and Horizontal Plane (HP)
Arrangement of views in First Angle: Front Elevation on top, Plan directly below, End Elevation on side
objectives: Draw the international first-angle projection symbol
Project the Front Elevation, Plan, and End Elevation of a stepped block with accurate alignment

topics.topic: Isometric Drawing vs Oblique Projection: Angles and Axes
subtopics: Isometric projection axes: vertical axis and two receding axes inclined at 30° to horizontal
Isometric box construction technique for shaping curved or irregular objects
Oblique projection: front face drawn true to shape with receding axis at 45° (Cabinet vs Cavalier)
objectives: Construct an isometric block drawing using a 30°/60° set-square and T-Square
Differentiate isometric from oblique projections in technical drafting

topics.topic: Metalwork Hand Tools: Hacksaws, Files, Chisels & Bench Vice
subtopics: Holding tools: engineer's bench vice, vice clamps (soft jaws to protect workpieces)
Hacksaw frame and blade mounting (teeth must point forward away from handle)
Types of engineering files: flat, hand, half-round, triangular, round, square
Cold chisels: flat, crosscut, round nose, diamond point
objectives: Mount a hacksaw blade with correct tension and teeth facing forward
Execute cross-filing and draw-filing techniques on mild steel plates

topics.topic: Woodwork Processing Machines: Circular Saw, Planer and Lathe
subtopics: Functions and operations of the circular saw (ripping and crosscutting timber)
Surface planer and thicknesser (producing smooth, uniform wooden boards)
Wood turning lathe: turning table legs, bowls, and spindles between centers
objectives: Identify parts of a circular saw machine: riving knife, crown guard, rip fence
State safety precautions when operating high-speed woodworking machinery

topics.topic: Metalwork Machine Tools: The Center Lathe & Drilling Machine
subtopics: The center lathe machine: headstock, tailstock, carriage, tool post, lead screw, bed
Lathe operations: turning, facing, chamfering, knurling, parting off
Sensitive bench drilling machine and pillar drill press: chuck, spindle, depth stop
objectives: Identify principal assemblies of the center lathe machine
Explain facing and cylindrical turning operations on metal workpieces

topics.topic: Friction in Machines: Lubrication, Bearings & Power Loss
subtopics: Effects of friction on industrial machine performance (wear, heat, power loss)
Methods of reducing friction: liquid lubricants (engine oils), solid lubricants (graphite, grease)
Types of bearings: journal (plain) bearings, ball bearings, roller bearings
objectives: Explain why machine bearings prevent rapid metal-on-metal abrasion
Select appropriate lubricant viscosity for motor vehicle engines and gearboxes

subtopics: Diagnostic evaluation on orthographic projection, metalwork tools, machines, and friction
Practical drafting test
objectives: Assess pupil mastery against JSS 2 technical benchmarks

topics.topic: Digital Fabrication, Elementary Robotics & Clean Energy in Nigeria
subtopics: Introduction to automated machines and solar energy conversions
Safety protocols in technology laboratories and workshops
Local assembly of emergency solar lanterns and circuit testing
objectives: Identify 3 clean energy sources in Nigeria.
Demonstrate safe handling of basic solar panels and DC meters.
Formulate a schematic diagram of a residential solar inverter setup.

topics.topic: Mechanical Drives II: Gears and Gear Trains
subtopics: Types of gears: spur gears (parallel shafts), bevel gears (intersecting shafts at 90°), worm and wheel (high speed reduction)
Gear ratio formula: Gear Ratio = Number of teeth on driven gear / Number of teeth on driver gear
Direction of rotation in meshed gears (adjacent meshed gears rotate in opposite directions)
objectives: Calculate gear speed ratios and output torque for 2-gear and 3-gear gear trains
Explain the role of an idler gear in reversing rotational direction without altering speed ratio

topics.topic: Building Construction I: Site Preparation & Setting Out (3-4-5 Method)
subtopics: Site clearing, removal of vegetable topsoil, and leveling
Setting out building foundations using profile boards, builder's line, pegs, and plumb bob
The 3-4-5 builder's square theorem for establishing exact 90° right angles at building corners
objectives: Demonstrate the 3-4-5 mathematical triangulation method on the school field
Construct profile boards and mark trench lines for strip foundations

topics.topic: Energy Conversion Systems: Generators, Batteries and Solar Panels
subtopics: Electromechanical energy conversion: petrol/diesel generators converting mechanical to electrical energy
Chemical cells: primary dry cells vs secondary lead-acid wet accumulator batteries
Photovoltaic solar panels: converting sunlight directly into DC electricity in Nigerian homes
objectives: Trace energy transformations from fuel combustion to domestic light output
Connect solar photovoltaic panels in series and parallel to supply specified voltage and current

topics.topic: Comprehensive Termly Revision & Machine Safety Masterclass
subtopics: Review of orthographic drawing, mechanical drives, lathe machines, and building construction
Practical engineering drafting and workshop examination
objectives: Complete JSS 2 Basic Technology Term 1 syllabus review

subtopics: Terminal examination and grading
objectives: Complete JSS 2 Basic Technology certification
